easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has indestructible and either flash or haste.
description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to the creature with indestructible.
Sonic's second ability triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

uses.name: Walking Ballista
uses.cardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
